prompt:
Photorealistic social media ad. In the foreground, a cream handwritten card taped to a warm cream wall, written with a black marker in neat casual handwriting, spelled EXACTLY:
WE ARE SO SORRY
...your dog doesn't want the couch anymore.
(The floor is heated now.)
Take 15% off with code COZY15
Below the card on the floor of a cozy living room, a golden retriever sleeps blissfully on exactly the gray paw-print heated pet pad from reference 1. In a corner of the card, small and neat, the wordmark 'CozyCompanion' from reference 2. Warm evening lamp light, cream, charcoal and rose tones, authentic, funny, premium. No other text.

Photorealistic social media ad. A yellow sticky note stuck on a white kitchen cabinet, handwritten in black marker, spelled EXACTLY:
WE ARE SO SORRY
your cat won't wake you up at 6 a.m. anymore.
15% off: COZY15
Below it, a tabby cat calmly eats breakfast from exactly the white automatic camera feeder from reference 1, soft early-morning light, a coffee mug on the counter. Small wordmark 'CozyCompanion' from reference 2 printed on the bottom edge of the sticky note. Funny, authentic, premium. No other text.

Photorealistic social media ad. A cream paper note lying on the clean gray quilted back seat dog bed from reference 1 inside an SUV, handwritten in black ink, spelled EXACTLY:
WE ARE SO SORRY
to all the dog hair that used to live in this car.
Code COZY15 = 15% off
A happy dog with its head resting next to the note, sunny golden-hour road-trip light through the windows. Small wordmark 'CozyCompanion' from reference 2 on the note. Funny, authentic, premium. No other text.

Social media ad designed like an iPhone Notes app screenshot on a clean light background. Title in bold: 'Things I stopped worrying about'. Checklist lines, spelled EXACTLY:
✓ Feeding him on time when I work late
✓ The 6 a.m. breakfast alarm (it was the cat)
✓ Weekend trips
✓ 'Did anyone feed the cat?'
Below the list, a pasted photo inside the note: a tabby cat eating from exactly the white automatic camera feeder from the reference. Clean, native iOS look, very realistic UI, no other text.

Social media ad designed like an iPhone iMessage conversation screenshot. Messages spelled EXACTLY, left gray bubbles are 'Mom', right blue bubbles are me:
Mom: Why is the dog not on the couch anymore??
Me: She has a heated bed now
Me: [photo]
Mom: ...can I borrow it
The [photo] message is a real photo of a small fluffy dog sleeping blissfully on exactly the rose-pink heated pet pad from the reference. Realistic iOS UI, clean, funny, no other text.

Bold, high-end graphic social media ad. Deep charcoal #1a1a1a background with a soft spotlight. Huge elegant serif headline in cream at the top, spelled EXACTLY: 'THE BACK SEAT, UPGRADED.' In the center, a dramatic studio photo of exactly the gray quilted back seat dog bed from reference 1, set up, with a beagle lying on it, floating with a soft shadow. At the bottom, a thin rose-gold line and small cream text spelled EXACTLY: 'Waterproof · Flat · Fits most cars'. Small 'CozyCompanion' wordmark from reference 2 in cream at the very bottom. Luxury fashion-ad aesthetic. No other text.

Photorealistic UGC-style social ad: first-person view of a hand holding a smartphone in a busy airport departure lounge, the phone screen shows a live camera feed of a cat and a small dog eating side by side from exactly the black double-bowl automatic camera feeder from the reference. Bold white caption text with black outline at the top, TikTok style, spelled EXACTLY: 'POV: you're at the airport and still watching them eat breakfast'. Authentic, warm, no other text.

Photorealistic premium unboxing flat lay from above on a cream linen surface: a matte charcoal gift box with a rose-gold CC monogram from reference 2 on the lid, opened, with blush tissue paper, revealing exactly the gray paw-print heated pet pad from reference 1 neatly folded with its controller; a small cream card handwritten in elegant ink, spelled EXACTLY: 'For the one who always finds the warmest spot.' A curious cat paw reaching into the frame. Soft daylight, holiday gift feeling, sprigs of eucalyptus. No other text.

Editorial social media ad with clean typography: a bright photo of exactly the gray quilted back seat dog bed from the reference installed in an SUV with a happy goldendoodle on it, rear door open. Overlaid with three small cream rounded labels with thin pointer lines to the product, spelled EXACTLY: '1  Firm, flat base', '2  Waterproof cover', '3  Mesh window'. Headline at the top in elegant charcoal serif on a cream band, spelled EXACTLY: '3 reasons your dog will love road trips'. Clean, premium, no other text.

Photorealistic holiday social media ad: exactly the light gray felt pet den from reference 1 under a softly lit Christmas tree, tied with a big rose-gold satin bow, a kitten peeking out of its round opening. Elegant cream serif headline at the top, spelled EXACTLY: 'The gift they'll actually use.' and below it smaller: 'Free tracked shipping over $150'. Small 'CozyCompanion' wordmark from reference 2 at the bottom in cream. Warm candlelight, charcoal and cream tones, magical, premium. No other text.
